        for neighbor in graph[current_node]:

        return None

        current_node = path[current_node]

def find_path(graph, start, goal):
    unvisited = set(graph)
    visited = set()
    path = []
    unvisited.remove(start)
    visited.add(start)
    path.append(start)
    while unvisited:
        current_neighbors = set(graph[start]) - visited
        if goal in current_neighbors:
            unvisited.remove(goal)
            visited.add(goal)
            path.append(goal)
            return path
        current_node = min(current_neighbors, key=lambda node: len(graph[node]))
        unvisited.remove(current_node)
        visited.add(current_node)
        path.append(current_node)
        start = current_node
        if goal in graph[current_node]:
            path.append(goal)
            return path
    return None
